metadataRaw.title: How to Safely POP Your Middle Back
metadataRaw.description:
Does your middle back feel locked up and tight and it just feels like it needs to be released with a pop or crack? 

In this video, Dr. Rowe shows you how to safely crack your middle back for INSTANT RELIEF. 

All of these middle back self mobilization exercises are EASY, effective and can give fast relief, even in as little as 30 SECONDS. 

That way you'll be able to release pressure in the mid back (thoracic spine) QUICKLY, and get the pop or crack you're looking for. They can be done at home or work, pretty much ANYPLACE and ANYTIME!

Watch now and safely pop your middle back at home for quick relief! 

Link to foam roller: https://amzn.to/3priAn2 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:44 Middle Back Corkscrew
2:53 School House Pop
4:39 Bed Traction Exercise
